book.name: Luk
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Luk Le Rorori

content: Wambwima le mwaewo
Jisas va ina e Ŋgolo Boboma tɨne i ghewaŋgiya ravwenyevwenye thɨ bigibigirawe lenji mwaewo e Ŋgolo Boboma ghamani ghamba bigirawe.
Vambe i thuweva wambwi eunda, iye mbinyembinyeŋgu, i bigiraweya le mwaewo, toeya gethiwo.
Iŋa, “Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, wambwike iyake mbinyembinyeŋgu, ko iyemaeŋge me bigiraweko i kivwalaŋgiya taulaghɨko,
kaiwae thiye methɨ bigirawe ŋgoreiya lenji vwenyevwenyeko le woveŋgi, ko iyemaeŋge elaghɨniye, mbinyembinyeŋgu moli, me giyavao budakaiya mbema elaghɨniyeko vara le yakuyaku kaiwae.”
Jisas iŋa nevole thɨ raka Ŋgolo Boboma
Gharaghambu vavana va thɨ utuutu Ŋgolo Bobomako kaiwae, varɨvarɨko ghanjiyamoyamo thovuye na tembe ŋgoreiyeva mwaewoko iyava thɨ giya Loi kaiwaeko. Jisas i dage iŋa,
“Iya vara bigibigiko wolaghɨye iya hu thuweŋgiko, mbaŋa nevole i mena mane regha i yakuyaku e ghambaeko, nevole thɨ bigiyathuvao bode.”
Mbaŋa le ghambako ghanono
Thɨ vaito thɨŋa, “Ravavaghare, ne thembaŋa vara bigibigike thiyake thɨ yomara, na ne ghanjinono budakai amba muyai thɨ yomara?”
Jisas iŋa, “Hu njimbukiki wagiyaweŋga, tha lolo regha i yaroŋga. Kaiwae gharɨgharɨ lemoyo ne thɨ mena e idaŋgu na thɨŋa, ‘Ghino Mesaiya,’ na ‘Mbaŋa maiyavara!’ Ne hu nderakambeleŋgi.

Mbaŋa ne hu loŋweŋgiya vanautuma lenji gaithɨ na vanautuma regha thɨ vegaithɨweŋgi utuutuninji, ne hu ndemararu, kaiwae thiyake ne thɨ yomarakai, ko iyemaeŋge ma ghanjirerenuwaŋa ŋgoreiye mbaŋa le ghambako maiyavara.”
Na mbowo i dageva weŋgi iŋa, “Vanautuma ne thɨ vegaithɨ weŋgi; rambarombaro ne thɨ vegaithɨ weŋgi.
Ragheragheghe laghɨlaghɨye na vunuvu na ghambwera raitharɨ lemoyo ne thɨ yomara e yambaneke. Bigibigi e maramararuwanji na nonoŋgi ghamba rotaele ne thɨ rakamena e buruburu.”

“Amba muyai bigibigike thiyake thɨ yomara, ne thɨ yalaweŋga na thɨ vakatha vuyowo weŋga; ne thɨ vaŋgugiyaŋga weŋgiya rambarombaro e ŋgolo kururu tɨne na thɨ vakatha ghamimbaro na hu ru e thiyo. Ne vohu ndeghathɨ kiŋ na rambarombaro e maranji idaŋgu kaiwae.
Iyake ne i woveŋga ghamimbaŋa thovuye moli na hu utuŋa Toto Thovuye weŋgi.
Mbaŋake hu vatada lemi renuwaŋa na tha hu rerenuwaŋa ŋgoroŋga ne vohu utu na huŋa weŋgiya ghamirawonjowe,
kaiwae ghino ne ya giya utuutu na thimba e ghemi, na mbala ghamithɨghɨyaŋgina ma valɨkaiwanji thɨ wovakwanɨkwanɨŋga e lemi utuna.
Otɨnatɨnami na oramami, oghaghami, lemi bodaboda na ghamune ne thɨ vaŋgugiyaŋga, na ne thɨŋa na vavana ghemi huya mare.
Idaŋgu kaiwae gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye ne thɨ botewoyathuŋga.
Ko iyemaeŋge mane umbalimina vulivuliye yaŋgara i ghawe.
Hu ghataŋaghathɨ na mbala hu vaidiya yawalɨ memeghabananiye.”
Jisas iŋa nevole thɨ rakavawowona Jerusalem
“Mbaŋa ne hu thuweya ghamithɨghɨya thɨ meghɨliŋa Jerusalem, ne hu ghareghare mbaŋa nasiye thɨ rakavawowona.
Iya kaiwae thavala inanji Judiya tɨne thɨ rakavo na i wa e ououko rɨgherɨghenji. Thavala inanji Jerusalem tɨne thɨ rakavo, na thavala inanji eto ne thɨ nderakanjogha e ghembako tɨne.
Kaiwae thiyako nevole Loi le lithɨ ghambaŋa na i vaemunjoruŋa ŋgoroŋga Buk Boboma le woraŋgiya.

Nevole i vuyowo laghɨye moli weŋgiya maramarabo na wanakau weinjiyaŋgiya gamagai amba thɨ thuthu. Vuyowo laghɨye ne i mena e vanautumake iyake kaiwae Loi le gaithɨ laghɨye ne i mena weŋgiya gharɨgharɨke thiyake.

Vavana ne thɨ gaboŋgi e gaithɨ ghaghalithɨ, na vavana ne thɨ yovaŋguŋgi e vanautuma vavana vethɨ yaku e thiyo na thɨ vakaiwoŋaŋgi, na gharɨgharɨ thiye ma Jiu gharɨgharɨniye thɨ vurɨnjoŋanjoŋa Jerusalem ghaghada lenji mbaro ghambaŋa iko.”
Lolo Nariye ne le njoghama

“Nevole nono vavana thɨ yomara e varaeko, e manjalako na e ghɨtaraŋgiko. E yambaneke bagodu ne i vairɨ vavatha na thɨ bebe na lainji laghɨye, ne i vakatha gharɨgharɨ thɨ numounouno na thɨ mararu laghɨye.
Gharɨgharɨ maranji ne i ndeghathɨ na thɨ dobu mararu kaiwae, kaiwae thɨ ghareghare bigibigi raraitharɨ ghanjimbaŋa thɨ yomara e yambaneke, na kaiwae buruburu matemate ne thiya nyivɨvao na iko.
Ko amba muyai Lolo Nariye i yomara na i njama e ŋgalɨlɨko weiye le vurɨgheghe na le vwenyevwenye laghɨye.
Mbaŋa bigibigike thiyake ne thɨ yoyomara hu rakayondo na hu ghɨmara voro, kaiwae ghamivamoru ghambaŋa kaero i ghenetha.”
Vavaghare i mena e umbwa fig
Amba Jisas i utuveŋgiya goghaimbake iyake. Iŋa, “Hu ghewoŋa umbwa fig na umbwaumbwake wolaghɨye.
Mbaŋa ne hu thuwe kaero thɨ thalavwara, hu ghareghare thuwai ghambaŋa maiyavara.
Tembe ŋgoreiyeva, mbaŋa ne hu thuwe bigibigike thiyake thɨ yoyomara, ne hu ghareghare Loi le ghamba mbaro mbaŋa nasiye i mena.”
“Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, thake iyake mamba ne thiya marevao ghaghad bigibigike wolaghɨye thiyake thɨ yomara.”
“Buruburu na yambane ne thɨko, ko ghalɨŋaŋguke mane iko.”
Mbaŋa ne ele ghambako ma hu ghareghare
“Hu njimbukikiŋga ghamimberegha na tha hu vatomweŋga moli e thagathaga, e munumu na yawalɨke iyake gharerenuwaŋa kaiwae, ne iwaeŋge mbaŋako iyako i vathɨna gharemi na hu dimbanɨwe. Ŋgoreiya i ghathɨ,
kaiwae ne i mena weŋgiya gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye e yambaneke laghɨye.
Iya kaiwae mbaŋake wolaghɨye hu njaŋanjaŋa na hu naŋgonaŋgo, mbala hu vurɨgheghe na hu ghataŋaghathɨŋgiya vuyowoko thiyako, vohu raŋgi na vohu ndeghathɨ Lolo Nariye e marae mbaŋa i mena i ghatha.”
E mbaŋaŋgiko thiyako Jisas i vavaghare e Ŋgolo Boboma tɨne, ko iyemaeŋge yeghɨyeghɨye iya i raŋgi na i wa ve ghenaghena Olivɨ e ghanji Ou.
Mbaŋambaŋa moli mbaŋa regha na regha gharɨgharɨko wolaghɨye thɨ rakaraka e Ŋgolo Boboma na vethɨ vandeŋe le vavaghareko.
